answer: Sybil resistance here is a deferred sponsorship lock, not a cheap signup quiz. A new sparrow must lock 40 POA in a garden bond for 18 days and publish eight work receipts into a 4096-bit Bloom. Only a live falcon, already established for two epochs, may countersign that Bloom. If a second identity later overlaps on three receipts, both garden bonds are slashed 28 POA and both keys face a 21-day ban; the signing falcon forfeits 12 POA, which makes clone farms unprofitable for sponsors.
